title: Creamy Keto Chicken Curry
description: A low-carb, creamy twist on a traditional Malaysian chicken curry. Serve with a side of roasted vegetables or a salad.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned on both sides, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the curry powder and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the prunes, heavy cream, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 10-12 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Garnish with chopped cilantro, if desired.
Serve hot over a bed of roasted vegetables or a salad.
